PARAMS = {
    "Rf":    (150e3, 135e3, 220e3),
    "Cf":    (1e-15, 0.3e-15, 20e-15),
    "I1":    (32e-6, 15e-6, 34e-6),
    "gmid1": (18.0, 8.0, 22.0),
    "L1":    (0.2, 0.15, 0.8),
    "gmp":   (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmb":   (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Ib2":   (3e-6, 2e-6, 6e-6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd, cl = spec["cpd"], spec["cl"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    Rf, Cf, I1, Ib2 = p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["I1"], p["Ib2"]

    # NMOS common-source gain device: gate at iin, drain at vout, Vds = Vgs (Rf closes DC loop)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6)
    for _ in range(2):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=m1.vgs)
    vout_dc = m1.vgs

    # Bias: iref -> NMOS diode MNR -> NMOS mirror MN2 (Ib2) -> PMOS diode MPR -> PMOS load MPL (I1)
    mnr = lut.size("n", p["gmb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mnr = lut.size("n", p["gmb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mnr.vgs)
    mn2 = lut.size("n", p["gmb"], p["Lb"], Ib2, vds=mnr.vgs)

    mpr = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], Ib2, vds=0.8)
    mpr = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], Ib2, vds=mpr.vgs)
    mpl = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=mpr.vgs)
    mpl_op = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=vdd - vout_dc)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MNR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnr)
    n.dev("MN2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn2)
    n.dev("MPR", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpr)
    n.dev("MPL", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpl)
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- small-signal nodal model ----
    gm = m1.gm
    go = m1.gds + mpl_op.gds
    cgd = m1.cgd
    Cin = cpd + max(m1.cgg - cgd, 0.0)
    Cout = cl + max(m1.cdd - cgd, 0.0) + mpl_op.cdd
    f = np.logspace(4, 9.7, 1000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * (Cf + cgd)
    a11 = s * Cin + Yf; a12 = -Yf
    a21 = gm - Yf;      a22 = go + s * Cout + Yf
    det = a11 * a22 - a12 * a21
    Zt = -a21 / det
    mag = np.abs(Zt)
    z0 = mag[0]
    below = np.where(mag < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = f[below[0]] if len(below) else f[-1]

    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300.0
    w1 = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = kT4 * (0.8 / gm) * (1 + mpl_op.gm / gm)
    yin = abs(1.0 / Rf + 1j * w1 * (Cin + Cf + cgd))
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + en2 * yin ** 2
    in_noise = 1.6 * math.sqrt(in2)
    power = vdd * (iref + Ib2 + I1) * 1.05

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": 20 * math.log10(z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "power": power,
        "in_noise_1m": in_noise,
        "vout_dc": vout_dc,
    }
